turns: 8; I wrote `e2e/api/generated/AUTH-06.spec.ts` with one test tagged `@AUTH-06`. It passes with `npx playwright test --project=api api/generated/AUTH-06.spec.ts`, and `npx tsc --noEmit` produced no errors. The `tsc` exit code wasn't captured (I piped it through `tail`), but it printed nothing.

The test signs in as `member@northwind.test` through `/api/auth/login`, which stores the session cookie in the test's own request context. It then calls `POST /api/auth/logout` and asserts:
- the status is 204, using `expectStatus`;
- a `session` Set-Cookie header is present;
- that header clears the cookie: an empty value, `Max-Age=0`, or the Unix-epoch `Expires`.

The sign-out path is `/api/auth/logout`, taken from `frontend/lib/session.tsx` and `backend/tests/test_auth.py`. The test doesn't change any shared data, so it doesn't conflict with parallel tests.

I did not run `npm run lint`. The `!` non-null assertion on `cookie` may trip a lint rule, and I didn't check.
